name: Annotations Webform
description: Integrates Annotations with Webform: target plugins for webform config entities and submission forms, plus overlay triggers during form fill.
project_description: Annotations Webform makes Webforms and their submissions annotatable. It adds a WebformTarget plugin (each webform is its own target, no field-level annotations) and a WebformSubmissionTarget plugin (enumerates a webform's input elements as annotatable fields), a decorator that resolves element #title labels for submission targets, and a form_alter that injects annotation overlay triggers into webform submission forms (which place elements under $form['elements'] where the base overlay skips them). Requires webform, annotations, and annotations_overlay.
